review.shorterRoute: Restrict the existing integral diagonal conjugation to Gamma1 and reuse the literal H1 trace. The existing explicit Shapiro cocycle lift and its proved coboundary homotopy identify this trace with the native Shapiro/coinduction transfer already proved surjective in scope 591. Native induction tensor evaluation and inversion of right/left cosets identify the coinduction counit. No new resolution, assumed transfer convention or arbitrary chosen Hecke action is introduced.
